level.theme: Ominous and oppressive, with roaring lava, constant tremors, and the distant sound of molten rivers flowing through the earth.
level.setting: A dark, smoldering volcanic labyrinth filled with magma rivers, unstable terrain, and ancient ruins that hint at past civilizations destroyed by the volcano's fury.
level.player_weapon: Tectonic Gauntlet (a weapon that channels seismic energy, capable of creating fissures and quakes)

encounters.hazard: Crushing rockfalls

pickup.name: Lava Core (a glowing red crystal)
pickup.effect: Increases player's seismic energy output by 30%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Magma Golem, the cavern collapses, revealing a hidden path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Lava surges and heat damage

pickup.name: Obsidian Shard (a black, sharp mineral fragment)
pickup.effect: Reflects 20% of enemy damage back at them for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Pyro Wraith causes the lava to thin, forming a bridge leading to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Continuous lava explosions and magma pillars

pickup.name: Volcanic Essence (a powerful energy source)
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player health and increases seismic energy by 50%

encounters.trigger: Erupting Guardian is awakened by the player's presence and begins to unleash waves of molten fury.

boss.name: Erupting Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Erupting Guardian using the Obsidian Shard to reflect its attacks and break its core.

level.objective: Navigate the molten depths of the Volcanic Wastes and defeat the Erupting Guardian, a corrupted elemental force of fire.
level.reward: Volcanic Essence, granting the player enhanced elemental control and survival in fire-based environments.

level.theme: Chaotic volcanic environment with erupting geysers, flaming rockfalls, and molten rivers.
level.setting: A dangerous fissure in the earth where fire and chaos are eternal. The level is constantly shifting, forcing the player to adapt to the environment.

encounters.hazard: Lava Pits

pickup.name: Molten Core
pickup.effect: Increases Ignis Brand's damage by 30% for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeat Ember Wraith to unlock a path through the lava flow leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Flame Storms

pickup.name: Firestone
pickup.effect: Temporary shield that reflects 50% of enemy damage for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: After surviving the flame storms and defeating the Scorched Golem, the ground trembles and a path opens to the Magma Warden.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Lava Pillars

pickup.name: Pyro Crown
pickup.effect: Unlocked mastery of fire, granting permanent 20% damage boost to Ignis Brand

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Magma Warden with the Firestone's damage reflection, the chamber explodes, revealing the Pyro Crown.

boss.name: Magma Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat using Firestone's reflected damage to break its molten armor.

level.objective: Survive the chaos of the Volcanic Rift and defeat the molten guardian, the Magma Warden, by mastering fire and exploiting weaknesses revealed through the trials.
level.reward: Pyro Crown (permanent damage boost to Ignis Brand)

level.theme: Tense, dangerous, and filled with molten hazards that challenge the player's reflexes and strategy.
level.setting: A volcanic cavern filled with glowing magma rivers, ancient shrines, and corrupted constructs that serve the fire spirit.
level.player_weapon: Flamebrand Scepter – a holy weapon imbued with divine fire, capable of purifying the corrupted.

encounters.hazard: Lava flows that can erupt if the player steps too close.

pickup.name: Ashen Relic
pickup.effect: Increases holy damage by 10%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ember Warden, the lava flows shift, revealing a path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars that can crush the player.

pickup.name: Seared Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorbs 15% of damage taken and reflects it back

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Cinder Construct triggers a tremor that opens the way to the volcano's core.

encounters.hazard: Explosive lava geysers that erupt when the spirit is agitated.

pickup.name: Flamebrand Sigil
pickup.effect: Unlocks a special ability: Divine Inferno – a powerful AoE attack that purges corruption.

encounters.trigger: The fire spirit awakens as the player enters the core, drawing them into a final, tense showdown.

boss.name: Corrupted Fire Spirit
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the spirit using the Seared Amulet's damage reflection to weaken it.

level.objective: Navigate through the molten heart of the volcano, protect the sacred flame, and defeat the corrupted fire spirit that has taken control of the volcano's core.
level.reward: Flamebrand Sigil – the paladin's true holy artifact, allowing them to master fire for both protection and attack.

level.theme: Desolate volcanic terrain with lava flows, ash clouds, and unstable rock formations
level.setting: Ancient, abandoned volcano with remnants of a forgotten civilization, now overgrown with magma and fire.
level.player_weapon: Blazing Scythe (Fire-infused, deals high damage to magma-based enemies)

encounters.hazard: Lava flows and unstable terrain

pickup.name: Fragments of Pyrothorn's Core
pickup.effect: Grants 25% resistance to fire and reveals hidden paths in the volcano.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Magma Golem causes the ground to crack open, revealing the next path toward the magma chamber.

enemy.name: Ashborn Wraith
enemy.weakness: Fragments of Pyrothorn's Core (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock formations and toxic gas clouds

pickup.name: Volcanic Core Resonator
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to disrupt enemy armor and reveal hidden weak points.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ashborn Wraith triggers a tremor that opens a passage into the heart of the volcano.

encounters.hazard: Explosive magma eruptions and collapsing ceiling

pickup.name: Pyrothorn's Magma Heart
pickup.effect: Power-up that permanently increases fire damage by 30% and grants immunity to fire for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ashborn Wraith leads to the Core Chamber where the molten titan, Pyrothorn, awaits.

boss.name: Pyrothorn
boss.victory_condition: Destroy Pyrothorn's Magma Heart using the Volcanic Core Resonator.

level.objective: Navigate the molten ruins of the Ashen Wastes and defeat the molten titan known as Pyrothorn.
level.reward: Pyrothorn's Magma Heart, granting permanent fire damage boost and fire immunity

level.theme: Mysterious volcanic ruins with ancient tech and arcane energy
level.setting: A long-forgotten artificer sanctuary, now overrun by molten spirits and rogue constructs.
level.player_weapon: Thermal Scepter (a tool that emits controlled bursts of heat, used to manipulate molten rock and weaken metal enemies)

encounters.hazard: Falling ash clouds that obscure vision

pickup.name: Obsidian Lens
pickup.effect: Improves the player's ability to spot hidden dangers and weak points in enemies

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ember Wraith, the ground cracks open, revealing a hidden passage leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Ironclad Construct
enemy.weakness: Obsidian Lens (allows the player to target the construct's joints)

encounters.hazard: Lava flows that can damage the player if not avoided

pickup.name: Furnace Core
pickup.effect: Can be used as a power-up to temporarily boost the Thermal Scepter's damage output

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Ironclad Construct, a tremor shakes the chamber, causing the ancient lava gates to open, revealing the final path.

enemy.name: The Forge Titan (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Furnace Core (the core must be activated and aimed at the Titan's heart)

encounters.hazard: Explosive geysers and collapsing rock pillars

pickup.name: Molten Artifact
pickup.effect: Completes the level and unlocks new artificer abilities

encounters.trigger: After the player retrieves the Furnace Core from the second encounter, they must pass through the lava gates to confront the Forge Titan.

boss.name: The Forge Titan
boss.weakness: Furnace Core (must be activated using the Obsidian Lens to target the Titan's heart)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Titan's core using the Furnace Core, which can only be activated if the player has the Obsidian Lens to aim accurately and the Thermal Scepter to deliver the final blow.

level.objective: Navigate through the volcanic ruins of Mount Aeternis to uncover the lost artifact of the Molten Forge before the volcano erupts.

level.theme: Eerie volcanic atmosphere with flickering lava lights, echoing thunder, and the distant howl of the Warden.
level.setting: Deep within the heart of Mount Vorthane, a once-sacred volcano now corrupted by an ancient evil.
level.player_weapon: Stormbrand, a lightning-infused staff capable of summoning thunderstorms and channeling electricity.

encounters.hazard: Periodic volcanic tremors and falling ash

pickup.name: Volcanic Core Shard
pickup.effect: Increases Stormbrand’s lightning damage by 25%

encounters.trigger: Ember Wraith’s defeat triggers a tremor that collapses the cavern, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Lava flows and steam vents

pickup.name: Storm Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Allows Stormbrand to summon a temporary storm shield for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Magma Golem releases a plume of steam that reveals a hidden chamber leading to the Obsidian Warden’s lair.

encounters.hazard: Crushing heat, volcanic explosions, and a shifting obsidian terrain

pickup.name: Stormheart Amulet
pickup.effect: Unlocks a powerful storm ultimate ability for the Stormcaller

encounters.trigger: The Warden senses the player’s approach and begins to summon a storm of fire and lightning to seal the mountain forever.

boss.name: Obsidian Warden
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Warden’s core with a concentrated burst of lightning using the Storm Resonance Crystal

level.objective: Navigate the volatile depths of Mount Vorthane and survive the volcanic wrath of the Obsidian Warden, the volcano’s ancient guardian.
level.reward: Stormheart Amulet and permanent increase in lightning damage for all future encounters.

level.theme: A whimsical, cartoonish volcanic world filled with quirky enemies and playful hazards.
level.setting: Molten Mirth is a vibrant and absurd volcanic region where lava flows like rivers of syrup, geysers giggle, and creatures are made of molten joy.

encounters.hazard: Lava Bubbles: Players must avoid floating lava bubbles to avoid taking 5 damage.

pickup.name: Puff of Playful Powder
pickup.effect: Grants +2 damage to the Whimsy Whistle for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: The Marmot's laughter echoes across the lagoon, drawing the attention of a giggling lava spirit who awakens the next encounter.

enemy.name: Giggling Geyser Golem
enemy.weakness: Puff of Playful Powder (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: Spontaneous eruptions of harmless but disorienting steam that slow movement.

pickup.name: Bubblegum Bait
pickup.effect: Attracts the boss's attention, reducing its damage by 3 for the next fight.

encounters.trigger: The Golem's laughter triggers an eruption that reveals a hidden path leading to the boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with floating bubbles that can be used to distract the boss or cause minor damage to it.

pickup.name: Volcano Voucher
pickup.effect: Unlocks a special reward in the game’s shop, granting a permanent +5 damage to the Whimsy Whistle.

encounters.trigger: After the battle, the Baron vanishes, leaving behind a glowing voucher and a path to the next whimsical zone.

boss.name: Bubbly Bubble Baron
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Baron using the Bubblegum Bait to reduce his damage and avoid the whimsical traps in the chamber.

level.objective: Navigate through the whimsical volcanic world of Molten Mirth, guiding your beastmaster companion through three whimsical encounters and a boss, each with unique weaknesses tied to previous pickups.

level.theme: A serene volcanic realm where time flows in an almost meditative rhythm, despite the molten danger lurking beneath the surface.
level.setting: A land of glowing obsidian, slow-moving rivers of magma, and ancient stone pillars etched with time runes.
level.player_weapon: Chrono Lance (a staff that allows the player to rewind time briefly or slow it down for a limited duration)

enemy.name: Ember Wraith
enemy.weakness: Chrono Lance's time rewind effect can reverse the wraith's attacks, causing it to hit itself.

encounters.hazard: Periodic lava bursts from the ground.

pickup.name: Eternal Ember
pickup.effect: Increases Chrono Lance's rewind duration by 1 second.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Ember Wraith, the ground shakes and a lava flow opens the path to the next area.

enemy.name: Echo Sentinel
enemy.weakness: The Eternal Ember picked up earlier can be used to disrupt the Sentinel's time mirroring, causing it to lose its temporal immunity.

encounters.hazard: Reflections of the player's past selves attack in loops.

pickup.name: Chrono Crystal
pickup.effect: Allows the player to store a single time-based ability for later use.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Echo Sentinel, the mirrors shatter and reveal a hidden passage leading to the final chamber.

encounters.location: The Heart of the Molten Core

enemy.name: Molten Chrono Drake
enemy.weakness: The Chrono Crystal from the previous encounter can be used to freeze the Drake in time for a short duration, allowing the player to land critical hits with the Chrono Lance.

encounters.hazard: Explosive magma geysers and time distortions.

pickup.name: Eternal Flame Core
pickup.effect: Permanently increases Chrono Lance's damage by 15.

encounters.trigger: The battle with the Drake begins immediately upon entering the chamber.

boss.name: Molten Chrono Drake
boss.weakness: The Chrono Crystal allows the player to freeze the Drake, making it vulnerable to the Chrono Lance's enhanced damage.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Drake using the Chrono Crystal to freeze it, then strike with the Chrono Lance for critical damage.

level.objective: Navigate through the volcanic realm to reach the Heart of the Molten Core, while mastering the flow of time to survive the challenges ahead.
level.reward: Eternal Flame Core (permanent upgrade to the Chrono Lance), access to the Chrono Sanctum, and a glimpse into the future of the volcanic realm.

level.theme: A tranquil celestial realm, bathed in golden light and soft, echoing chimes.
level.setting: A floating spire in the sky, surrounded by clouds and celestial bodies, with glowing runes etched into the walls.
level.player_weapon: Lumina's Oath (a radiant sword imbued with divine light that grows stronger with each celestial ally it purifies)

enemy.name: Shrouded Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Lumina's Oath (light-based attacks deal double damage)

encounters.hazard: A faint mist obscures vision, reducing accuracy by 15%.

pickup.name: Celestial Essence
pickup.effect: Increases Lumina's Oath damage by 25% when equipped.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel removes the mist, revealing a glowing path upward.

enemy.name: Echoing Wraith
enemy.weakness: Celestial Essence (when equipped, the Wraith's echo attacks are silenced)

encounters.hazard: The bridge shakes with every step, causing random falls that reduce player health by 10%.

pickup.name: Starlight Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorbs 10% of enemy damage and converts it into a healing aura for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Wraith stabilizes the bridge, revealing the final path to the Astral Spire.

enemy.name: The Astral Harbinger
enemy.weakness: Starlight Amulet (when equipped, the Harbinger's attacks are reflected back as damage)

encounters.hazard: The spire pulses with unstable energy, reducing player movement speed by 30%.

pickup.name: Celestial Beacon Core
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds when activated.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Harbinger unlocks the Celestial Beacon Core, which must be placed in the central pedestal to complete the level.

boss.name: The Astral Harbinger
boss.weakness: Starlight Amulet (when equipped, the Harbinger's attacks are reflected back as damage)
boss.victory_condition: Place the Celestial Beacon Core in the pedestal to restore balance and complete the level.

level.objective: Protect the Celestial Beacon from corrupted celestial entities and reach the heart of the Astral Spire to restore balance.
level.reward: Celestial Harmony (a permanent stat boost to light-based attacks and healing abilities)

level.theme: Mysterious celestial environment filled with shifting time phenomena, ancient glyphs, and distorted starfields.
level.setting: A shattered celestial realm where time flows in non-linear patterns, with floating ruins, collapsing stars, and ghostly echoes of past and future.

enemy.name: Time-Echo
enemy.weakness: The Chrono Anchor, if charged with temporal energy from the Observatory's core.

encounters.hazard: The area is unstable—time loops and memory echoes cause confusion and damage over time.

pickup.name: Temporal Crystal
pickup.effect: When used in the Chrono Anchor, doubles the weapon's damage for the next 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Time-Echo stabilizes the time lattice, revealing a hidden portal leading to the next zone.

enemy.name: Chrono Drifter
enemy.weakness: The Temporal Crystal, if embedded in the Drifter’s timeline anomaly.

encounters.hazard: The timeline shifts unpredictably—player can be sent back in time or forward to a corrupted future.

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Absorbs corrupted time fragments, granting immunity to time-based hazards for 20 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Chrono Drifter reveals a vision of the Chronophage, triggering the final encounter.

enemy.name: Chronophage
enemy.weakness: The Echo Core, which must be used to destabilize the Chronophage’s form before it can be damaged.

encounters.hazard: The area is collapsing—player must maintain a stable timeline to avoid being consumed by time rifts.

pickup.name: Chrono Seal
pickup.effect: Seals the Chronophage in time, allowing the player to escape the collapsing Nexus.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Chronophage stabilizes the Nexus and allows the player to escape the collapsing realm.

boss.name: Chronophage
boss.weakness: The Echo Core, which must be embedded in the Chronophage's core before it can be attacked.
boss.victory_condition: Use the Echo Core to weaken the Chronophage, then defeat it with the Chrono Anchor charged with the Temporal Crystal.

level.objective: Navigate through the fractured time-lattice of the Astral Nexus and confront the Chronophage, an ancient entity that has fractured time itself.
level.reward: Chrono Seal (allows the player to time-travel to previous encounters for re-engagement or research).

level.setting: A corrupted void of space and time, where stars burn cold and shadows whisper secrets of the end.

enemy.name: Stellar Wraith
enemy.weakness: Celestial Shadowblade's energy core must be activated to bypass its void barrier.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Fluctuations

pickup.name: Void Crystal Core
pickup.effect: Activates the Celestial Shadowblade's energy core, allowing it to bypass void barriers.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Stellar Wraith causes a rift in space, revealing the path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Eclipse Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Requires the Void Crystal Core to disrupt its shield.

encounters.hazard: Energy Drains

pickup.name: Shattered Eclipse Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see hidden paths and enemy weaknesses.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Sentinel's shield with the Void Crystal Core triggers a gravitational collapse, leading to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Nocturnis, Harbinger of the Eclipse
enemy.weakness: Must be struck with the Celestial Shadowblade while the Shattered Eclipse Lens is active.

encounters.hazard: Time Fractures, Reality Shatters

pickup.name: Eclipse Sigil
pickup.effect: Rewards the player upon victory, unlocking the Celestial Shadowblade's ultimate form.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the previous enemies has prepared the battlefield; Nocturnis is awakened in response to the player's presence.

boss.name: Nocturnis, Harbinger of the Eclipse
boss.victory_condition: Strike Nocturnis with the Celestial Shadowblade while the Shattered Eclipse Lens is active to bypass its time-based defenses.

level.objective: Navigate through the corrupted Celestial Expanse and confront the shadowy entity known as Nocturnis, the Harbinger of the Eclipse.

level.setting: A dreamlike realm filled with floating islands, glowing flora, and ever-shifting skies.

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with mirrored walls. The enemy duplicates itself, but only the original is vulnerable to the Mirage Wand.

pickup.name: Starlight Lens
pickup.effect: Enhances the Mirage Wand's ability to pierce illusions.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Reflection Shade reveals a hidden portal to the next area.

encounters.hazard: The Chime Bloom is a magical plant that hums a lullaby, slowing your movements. It can only be damaged by the Starlight Lens, which disrupts its harmonic energy.

pickup.name: Celestial Compass
pickup.effect: Guides the player to the boss's chamber and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Using the Starlight Lens to defeat the Chime Bloom activates a celestial pathway, leading to the final encounter.

encounters.hazard: The Starweaver weaves illusions that trap the player in endless loops. Only the Celestial Compass can track the true form of the boss.

pickup.name: Celestial Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the door to the next celestial realm.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Starweaver with the Celestial Compass unlocks the door to the next level, where the sky shimmers with new stars.

boss.name: The Illusion Queen
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Illusion Queen by targeting her true form, revealed only through the Celestial Compass.

level.objective: Navigate through the Celestial Whimsy, mastering illusions to guide your way through three encounters and face a final boss who is vulnerable only to a special item you must collect along the way.

level.theme: Chaotic celestial battle with unpredictable environmental hazards and deep lore tied to the stormcaller's power over the skies.
level.setting: A realm where the sky is broken, filled with unstable energy, and where storms rage uncontrollably.
level.player_weapon: Stormweaver's Conductor (a rod that channels lightning and controls atmospheric conditions)

enemy.name: Wrecker of Storms
enemy.weakness: Lightning conduction (the player must use the Stormweaver's Conductor in close quarters)

encounters.hazard: Storm pulses destabilize the platform; player must dodge to avoid falling.

pickup.name: Celestial Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Enhances Stormweaver's Conductor by 30% for 60 seconds, can be used to charge the player's next attack.

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Wrecker of Storms to open the path to the Celestial Rift.

enemy.name: Fury of the Void
enemy.weakness: Resonance Crystal (must be charged with the Stormweaver's Conductor to deal critical damage)

encounters.hazard: Electric storms and void vortexes pull the player into random locations; navigation requires timing and awareness.

pickup.name: Void Anchor
pickup.effect: Prevents the player from being pulled into void vortexes and grants 25% damage resistance.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Fury of the Void to reveal the path to the final celestial anomaly.

encounters.location: The Celestial Anomaly - The Fractured Core

enemy.name: The Celestial Anomaly
enemy.weakness: The Celestial Resonance Crystal (must be fully charged with the Stormweaver's Conductor before the final attack)

encounters.hazard: The battlefield is unstable, with random celestial shards and energy bursts; player must manage stamina and timing.

pickup.name: Celestial Harmony Core
pickup.effect: Restores the balance of the realm and unlocks the next level.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Celestial Anomaly, the realm stabilizes and the core is restored.

boss.name: The Celestial Anomaly
boss.weakness: Celestial Resonance Crystal (must be fully charged from the first encounter) used in conjunction with the Stormweaver's Conductor.
boss.victory_condition: Use the fully charged Celestial Resonance Crystal with the Stormweaver's Conductor in the final blow.

level.objective: Navigate the Celestial Fracture and restore balance by defeating the storm-wracked entities and the final celestial anomaly.
level.reward: Celestial Harmony Core, 5000 XP, and a new skill: 'Storm Surge' which temporarily increases damage by 50% and slows enemies.

level.theme: A desolate, broken celestial realm with drifting debris, flickering stars, and ancient ruins that whisper of lost knowledge.
level.setting: A dying star's surface, surrounded by a void of space, where gravity fluctuates and time feels distorted.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Fluctuations (random damage every 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Starlight Fragment
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Celestial Bow's 'Nova Shot' ability, dealing 100% bonus damage to the final boss.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Wraithling opens the first celestial portal, revealing a path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Echo Echoes (distracts player with illusions, reducing accuracy by 20% for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Celestial Rune
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health and temporarily boosts movement speed.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Void Warden activates a celestial beacon, revealing the path to the final encounter.

encounters.location: The Heart of the Dying Star

enemy.name: Starforged Sovereign
enemy.weakness: Nova Shot (unlocked by the Starlight Fragment from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Radiation Storm (random debuff on player: slows movement and reduces damage by 30% for 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Completes the player's mission and unlocks new abilities for future levels.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Starforged Sovereign, the player escapes through a collapsing wormhole to the next level.

boss.name: Starforged Sovereign
boss.weakness: Nova Shot (unlocked by the Starlight Fragment from the first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using Nova Shot (unlocked by Starlight Fragment).

level.objective: Navigate the desolate celestial ruins and reach the core of the dying star, surviving encounters and unlocking the key to the final gate.
level.reward: Celestial Core and permanent ability upgrades to the Celestial Bow.

level.setting: A surreal, fractured celestial plane filled with floating debris, gravitational anomalies, and echoes of forgotten starlight.
level.player_weapon: Celestial Wrench (a tool that can manipulate gravitational fields and phase through matter)

encounters.hazard: Fluctuating gravitational fields pull the player toward the center of the room, causing fall damage.

pickup.name: Fractured Star Shard
pickup.effect: Grants +50% gravitational field strength to Celestial Wrench

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating Gravity Spire, the Fractured Star Shard activates a gravitational portal leading to the next sector.

encounters.hazard: Echo Construct duplicates itself every 20 seconds, increasing threat level exponentially.

pickup.name: Celestial Core Residue
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of player's health and temporarily boosts damage by 40%

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Echo Construct causes a resonance wave that opens a rift to the final sector, where the Celestial Rift's heart is sealed.

encounters.hazard: The Sovereign generates a gravitational vortex that pulls the player into a time-loop, replaying the same 15 seconds of combat unless the Shard is used to break free.

pickup.name: Shattered Star
pickup.effect: Restores full health, grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds, and allows the player to restore balance to the cosmos.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Riftbound Sovereign with the Fractured Star Shard unlocks the Shattered Star, completing the mission.

boss.name: The Riftbound Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Fractured Star Shard, which was obtained from the Echo Construct encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the Celestial Rift to retrieve the Shattered Star and restore balance to the fractured cosmos.
level.reward: Shattered Star (grants the power to heal and restore balance to the celestial realms).

level.setting: A derelict orbital station orbiting a dying star, with floating debris and unstable gravitational fields.
level.player_weapon: Gravity Wrench - A tool that can manipulate nearby metallic objects, ideal for disarming or disabling machinery.

encounters.location: Orbital Repair Station - Docking Bay A3

enemy.name: Rift Drone
enemy.weakness: Gravity Wrench - The drone's metal plating is susceptible to gravitational distortion.

encounters.hazard: Unstable gravitational field disrupting the player's movement and vision.

pickup.name: Gravitic Stabilizer Chip
pickup.effect: Boosts the Gravity Wrench's effect by 30%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Rift Drone, the gravitational field stabilizes, revealing the path to the next section.

enemy.name: Nebula Construct
enemy.weakness: Gravitic Stabilizer Chip - The construct's energy core is unstable when exposed to gravitational flux.

encounters.hazard: Periodic energy surges that knock the player back and reduce visibility.

pickup.name: Quantum Lock Pick
pickup.effect: Allows access to the sealed quantum core door.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Nebula Construct, the core door unlocks, leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Celestial Warden
enemy.weakness: Quantum Lock Pick - The Warden's armor is fused with quantum-locked plating that can be bypassed with the Lock Pick.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing space-time anomalies that cause random teleportation or time distortions.

pickup.name: Celestial Core Seal
pickup.effect: Permanently stabilizes the rift and completes the mission.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Celestial Warden, the core is sealed and the rift is stabilized.

boss.name: Celestial Warden
boss.weakness: Quantum Lock Pick - The Warden's armor is fused with quantum-locked plating that can be bypassed with the Lock Pick.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Warden's core using the Quantum Lock Pick to bypass its defenses.

level.objective: Repair the damaged quantum core to stabilize the celestial rift and prevent a cosmic collapse.
